key_claims: As of early 1996, Bin Ladin was commander-in-chief of an Islamic Army with a General Shura Council whose members he appointed.
Abu Hajir al-Iraqi (aka Mamdouh Salim) managed Bin Ladin's overseas financial dealings, purchases and investments.
The Shura Council oversaw four committees: Political and Sharia, Financial and Administrative, Information, and Military.
Madini al-Tayyib supervised the Financial and Administrative Committee, responsible for all Islamic Army finances.
Abu 'Ubayda al-Banshiri was overall leader of the Military Committee.
